EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat all monsters!!
I didn't expect us to collect everything this\nfast. I feel like it's not challenging enough...\nBut whatever...
Let's bring them to Filecia and get our rewards\nasap!
Hey, isn't that the Broker Goblin who wanted to\nsell Lefina's sweets the other day? I wonder what\nthey're talking about.
Listen, gob! This time we must definitely get\nthe sweets that girl called Lefina made, gob!\nYou guys ready, gob?
I'm all set, gob!\nI can go get them anytime, gob!!
If there are no sweets, I'm ready to snatch the\ngirl who makes them too, gob!
But boss, what if that adventurer, shortie and\nthe girl who knows how to use magic showed up\nlike last time, gob?
What? Shortie? How dare he call me that?!
Gob gob gob! I was just startled cuz they suddenly\nshowed up last time! Had I not let my guard down,\nI woulda beat that weak adventurer easily, gob!
Hey! Who are you calling shortie?!
Whoaa!\nIs-isn't it obvious? If not you, who else, gob?!
H-how dare you show up again, gob!\nI-I-I'mma beat you up for sure this time, gobbb!!
I...I got beat up, gob...
Uh? What's this?
Gobbb?! T-that's...!!
Seems like a letter for Lefina written by\nAdonius...\nThe name Adonius sounds familiar...
Seriously?! It's that dark and handsome, but\ncorrupt merchant who tricked Lefina to make a lot\nof sweets on Valentine's Day,
then took all the sweets and tried to sell them\nto these ugly goblins!
His evil scheme got busted and he was beat up by\nFilecia's Kruztor!!
I can't believe that you really forgot...
Let's see, "I'm sorry that I couldn't receive\nthe sweets of your love last Valentine's Day,\nbut this time I want them for sure. Therefore,
please kindly hand the sweets to my servants..."\nReally?
Wow...It seems that you haven't learned your\nlesson at all despite all the terrible things that\nhappened to you! You guys too?
I'm sorry, gob! Please forgive me, gob!!
This time we were supposed to deceive Lefina with\nthat letter and share the sweets we get with\nAdonius equally, gob...
I promise I'll never mess with Lefina or touch her\nsweets again, gob! Forgive me, gob!!
Where are you supposed to meet Adonius to give him\nthe sweets?! Tell us!!
We...we planned to meet in the back alley of\nEl Scaro, gob! I'm telling the truth, gob!!
Since you've confessed everything, I'll let you\noff...\nBut remember! This will be the last time!!
O-okay, gobbb!!
Wait, wait!\nWe haven't finished gathering the ingredients yet!
